banner: 100% synthetic population; no real individuals; methodology demonstration.

config_comparison.lesson: The default threshold over-merges realistic households (shared surnames + addresses + family emails). Raising the probabilistic threshold to 0.92 recovers precision at minimal recall cost. Residual false merges are shared-household emails matched deterministically - the fix is identifier-frequency capping (engine roadmap).

vs_ground_truth.note: Computable ONLY because the truth is manufactured — the entire point of synthetic benchmarking.
